device.description: 12-bit dual micro-power voltage-output DAC with rail-to-rail outputs and 3-wire SPI
device.note: dac122s085.pdf (SNAS361E) p.2 pin configuration and descriptions, p.3 operating ratings (VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs up to 5.5 V regardless of VA), p.7-8 timing and Figure 2 serial timing, p.14-15 serial interface, input shift register (Figure 30), power-on reset, p.15-16 power-down modes (Table 1)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: input (DAC) register written by OP 00; power-on: filled with zeros

registers.name: INB
registers.note: input (DAC) register written by OP 00; power-on: filled with zeros

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC output latch; power-on: zeros (outputs 0 V until a valid write)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC output latch; power-on: zeros (outputs 0 V until a valid write)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: power-down state and the A1 A0 termination code of the last power-down frame (Table 1)

commands.name: Write register, no update
commands.note: Figure 30 OP1 OP0 = 00: write to the specified register but do not update outputs

commands.name: Write register and update outputs
commands.note: OP = 01: write to the specified register and update the outputs of all DACs

commands.name: Write all registers and update outputs
commands.note: OP = 10: write to all registers and update outputs (address bits ignored)

commands.name: Power-down outputs
commands.note: OP = 11: all DACs powered down; A1 A0 select the output termination (Table 1: 00/11 Hi-Z, 01 2.5k, 10 100k); DAC registers unaffected

protocol.note: 16-bit frame A1 A0 OP1 OP0 D11-D0, MSB first, executed on the 16th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high before the 16th edge aborts the frame; bits after the 16th edge are ignored

pages: p.2 (pins), p.3 (operating ratings), p.7-8 (timing, Figure 2), p.14-15 (serial interface, Figure 30, power-on reset), p.15-16 (Table 1 power-down)
notModeled: analog outputs, reference, settling, output terminations in power-down (PD code stored only)
wake-up: the datasheet only says registers keep their values unless changed by the write that recovers from power-down; the model wakes on any write frame
SPI mode: the part samples DIN on SCLK falling edges and accepts either clock polarity as long as SYNC does not fall on a falling SCLK edge; mode 2 per Figure 2
frames whose first bit is 1 (other than the power-down frame) are ignored: the datasheet requires the first bit to be 0
variants: DAC082S085 / DAC102S085 are the 8- and 10-bit family members (separate datasheets)
